items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: Well, Larry wanted me to bring him down there.

ctx.x: Yeah, he can play. But you can't talk to him, you know? He's got so funny, you can't talk to him. He hears all kind of voices and everything.
Well, Larry wanted me to bring him down there. I tried to get him down there. He told me to be there, but he never did show up.
Well, he said, I don't know. He was supposed to come out here once and play for some church. But he didn't come.
